long_description: Better Outcomes Now is the official web-based platform for implementing PCOMS (Partners for Change Outcome Management System), the feedback-informed treatment approach developed by Barry Duncan, PsyD and colleagues. The platform administers the Outcome Rating Scale (ORS) and Session Rating Scale (SRS) - the most widely used feedback measures globally with translations in over 25 languages. PCOMS is designated as an evidence-based practice by SAMHSA's National Registry of Evidence-based Programs and Practices (NREPP). The platform supports individual, couple, family, and group therapy with appropriate ORS/SRS versions for each modality. Better Outcomes Now provides real-time feedback graphs, predicted treatment trajectories, alerts for at-risk clients, and aggregate outcome reports. Research shows PCOMS can double the effectiveness of treatment while cutting dropout rates in half.

faqs.a: PCOMS (Partners for Change Outcome Management System) is an evidence-based feedback-informed treatment approach using the ORS and SRS to monitor outcomes and therapeutic alliance at every session.

faqs.q: How is Better Outcomes Now different from MyOutcomes?
faqs.a: Better Outcomes Now is developed by Barry Duncan, co-creator of the ORS/SRS. MyOutcomes is affiliated with Scott Miller and the ICCE. Both implement feedback-informed treatment with ORS/SRS.
Yes, PCOMS is designated as an evidence-based practice by SAMHSA's National Registry of Evidence-based Programs and Practices (NREPP). Research shows it can double treatment effectiveness.

faqs.q: What versions of ORS/SRS are available?
faqs.a: Better Outcomes Now includes individual ORS/SRS, child versions (CORS/CSRS), young child pictorial versions, group versions (GORS/GSRS), and couple/family versions in 25+ languages.
